operation.description:
This will trigger the hook with the latest push to the current repository if the hook is subscribed to `push` events. If the hook is not subscribed to `push` events, the server will respond with 204 but no test POST will be generated.

> [!NOTE]
> Previously `/repos/:owner/:repo/hooks/:hook_id/test`

#/components/parameters/hook-id.description: The unique identifier of the hook. You can find this value in the `X-GitHub-Hook-ID` header of a webhook delivery.
#/components/parameters/hook-id.name: hook_id

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo
